title: Cosmic Geometric Information Dynamics: A Conditional SL(6,C) Model with Explicit Spectral, Stochastic and Formalization Boundaries
content: We develop a conditional geometric-information dynamics model on the Riemannian configuration space XE = SL(6,C)/SU(6) and specify its interfaces with a separately supplied four-dimensional Lorentzian effective theory. Free-Laplacian thresholds, weighted-diffusion relaxation gaps and physical mediator masses are distinguished throughout. A charged scalar phase provides a dynamical clock candidate after an explicit matching choice; finite clock range can obstruct relaxation in physical time. Measured-space flux–force conjugacy, a quartic stationary-current witness and actual martingale expectation consequences strengthen the mathematical core. The quartic moment hierarchy also demonstrates that Gaussian closure is not dynamically invariant. A specified positive mediator spectrum bounds an attractive coupling and yields a neutral-condensation exclusion criterion, without determining CP violation. A spatial response map and noncollinear, temporally effective seeds are required to connect statistical covariance with gravitational-wave stress; a positive OU noise floor alone is insufficient. Explicit characteristic and stress-balance identities connect regular scalar propagation, receivers and the Friedmann constraint. Real-section reduction, continuum stochastic construction, the geometric spectral theorem, quantum stress and observational matching remain stated obligations.
